description: Andhra Pradesh Government AI Services: The Andhra Pradesh government is set to implement AI-driven services across various departments, bolstered by a new Centre of Excellence in Visakhapatnam and a partnership with NVIDIA to establish India's first dedicated AI University.
body_lead: Andhra Pradesh govt to roll out AI services across departments Mission Director Jignesh Talasila said the CoE plans to launch its second cohort by April, expanding intake and potentially addressing problem statements from beyond Andhra Pradesh at its Rushikonda campus The Andhra Pradesh govt is preparing to roll out artificial intelligence-based services across multiple public departments. In Sept 2025, the state signed a memorandum of understanding with the Tech Bharat Research Foundation to establish an AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Visakhapatnam, aimed at advancing AI for public good.
